lines.en: Do not step on the shoots in the mud.

lines.zh: 骨缝里卡着叶子，走不快。
lines.en: Leaves stuck in my ribs. I can't hurry.
Water under the muck. That way.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，没到我的膝盖。
lines.en: Swamp mud reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠上骨头，越缠越紧。
lines.en: Vines wrap my bones tighter and tighter.
Brighter to the east. East, then.
No trees ahead. I'll stand there a while.
Step light. There are worms in the mud.
The vine climbed another joint. Good.
My toes feel the way through the mud.
Moss in my bone seams. It itches.

lines.zh: 沼泽的藤蔓缠上我的肋骨。
lines.en: Swamp vines wrap my ribs.

lines.zh: 骨头插在泥里，就算扎根。
lines.en: Bones sunk in mud count as roots.

lines.zh: 枝上的芽，梦到自己是树。
lines.en: The bud dreams it's a tree.
Axe blows, on and off. I listen.

lines.zh: 泥里有东西在动，不是我。
lines.en: Something moves in the mud, and it isn't me.
A ring of small mushrooms at my feet. Don't step.

lines.zh: 青苔顺着腿骨往上爬了。
lines.en: Moss is creeping up my leg bone.
Vines cover my bones again.

lines.zh: 肋骨缝里的花，慢慢开吧。
lines.en: Bloom slowly, flower between my ribs.
The sun warms my bones right through.
I could stand till the rains end.
Basking long enough, the vines loosen.
Vines wrap around my arm.
Sun going west — my bone shadow stretches.

lines.zh: 沼泽一百年，也就一眨眼。
lines.en: A century in the swamp — one blink.

lines.zh: 叶尖的露，滴在我颅骨上。
lines.en: Dew from the leaf drips on my skull.
Vines have wound round my ribs.
Quiet. Roots are growing in my ribs.

lines.zh: 数骨节，一节一节数下去。
lines.en: Counting my joints, one by one.
Leave the axe be, and I'll stand still.

lines.zh: 走近些，我眼眶里全是泥。
lines.en: Come closer, my eye sockets are full of mud.
I stand steady in the murky water.

lines.zh: 别动，让我看看你的骨架。
lines.en: Hold still. Let me look at your frame.

lines.zh: 沼泽的藤蔓，缠在我肋骨上。
lines.en: Swamp vines wound around my ribs.
So you're the one Swamp Skeleton mentioned.

lines.zh: 泥水里的我，连影子都发绿。
lines.en: In the muck, even my shadow turns green.
Vines slow my steps.

lines.zh: 藤蔓是从我肋骨里长出来的。
lines.en: The vines grow out from between my ribs.
That iron smell at your cuff — an axe.

lines.zh: 沼泽的藤，缠着我的肋骨。
lines.en: Swamp vines snared my ribs.
The sound of your walk is new.
The swamp mud holds my feet up.

lines.zh: 断了一根肋骨，我数着呢。
lines.en: One rib cracked. I'm counting.
That vine is tied to my spine.
My collarbone split. A dull sound.

lines.zh: 沼泥漫到我的膝盖，走不快。
lines.en: The mire's up to my knees and I'm slow.
Bent bones, but still upright.
Not the joints. They're the brittle part.

lines.zh: 疼，从脚骨一直窜到颅骨。
lines.en: Pain runs from my foot bones to my skull.
The axe is stuck in my ribs. Pull.
That vine just took hold. Don't tear it.
Vines wind through my ribs.
That sapling — plant it in the mud for me.

lines.zh: 藤蔓上那片叶子，就一片。
lines.en: One leaf on the vine — just one.

lines.zh: 你倒的是水？我还以为是血。
lines.en: Is that water? I took it for blood.
Bring me a fistful of black mud — it tastes good.
Toss me a handful of rotted leaves. Enough.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠着骨头，咬不动人。
lines.en: Vines bind these bones — I can't bite.
Hold the torch over to the vines.

lines.zh: 就一口潮气，我骨头都干。
lines.en: Just one breath of damp. My bones are dry.

lines.zh: 沼泽的蘑菇味飘过来了。
lines.en: Swamp mushroom smell drifts over.

lines.zh: 你踩着我影子，骨头都响。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow — my bones clatter.
Vines snagged my leg bone.
Skip the bow. Go around through the mud.

lines.zh: 骨头没痛觉，可我有脾气。
lines.en: Bones feel no pain, but I have a temper.
I'm all cracks. Don't jostle me.

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚骨了，拔出来。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot bone. Lift it.

lines.zh: 沼泽的石头够多了，你也来。
lines.en: The swamp has stones enough. Now you.
Not painful, just very rude.

lines.zh: 那根枝条长在我背上十年了。
lines.en: That branch grew on my back ten years.
Grab that vine. Don't lean on me again.

lines.zh: 你身上的木香，我站不稳。
lines.en: The smell of wood on you makes me sway.
Your bones, my bones — let them twine.

lines.zh: 并排站着，根会自己缠上。
lines.en: Stand side by side; the roots will twine themselves.
Come closer. The vines block the wind.

lines.zh: 这根新藤，是我留给你的。
lines.en: This new vine — I grew it for you.

lines.zh: 泥水里的骨头，也认季节。
lines.en: Bones in the mire still know the season.

lines.zh: 我骨头缝里，开着小白花。
lines.en: Little white flowers bloom in my bone seams.
Vines are wrapped around my ribs.

lines.zh: 藤蔓从我骨缝里爬出来了。
lines.en: Vines are crawling out of my ribs.
The bloom lasts days. Hurry.
Once it's in my ribs, it stays.
Don't look. I'm tucking it in my ribs.

lines.zh: 这一点烂泥里的东西，够我笑。
lines.en: This bit of muck treasure is enough to make me grin.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，把我的骨头泡软了。
lines.en: Swamp mud softened my bones.

lines.zh: 我从泥里站起来，水往下滴。
lines.en: I stand up from the mud, water dripping.
Sniff first — mud or meat?
Pick it up and press it into the mud.
A shiny bit fits nicely in my ribs.
This pebble fits a gap in my ribs.

lines.zh: 藤蔓一勾，就到我手里了。
lines.en: One hook of a vine and it is in my hand.
Don't struggle. One joint's worth, quick.

lines.zh: 藤蔓从我的肋骨间穿过。
lines.en: Vines thread through my ribs.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠着我，像给我穿衣。
lines.en: Vines wrap me like clothes.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠着我的骨头，正好藏。
lines.en: Vines wrapped round my bones — good cover.

lines.zh: 你踩断的嫩枝，出卖了你。
lines.en: The shoot you snapped gives you away.
The wingbeats stopped. Right there.
I'm slow, but I always arrive.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枯枝，整片都听见。
lines.en: The whole grove heard that branch snap.
A vine is already around your ankle.
The vines have loosened. Come on.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我站得越定。
lines.en: The harder you breathe, the stiller I stand.
Mangrove roots closed the path. Turn back.
Vine forest. You won't get out.
Sweat in a swamp is hard to hide.
A vine went round your left.
Swamp bones sink heavier than mud.
Slow, but never stopping.
Bones against mud — an inch a step.
You stop one step; I close one.

lines.zh: 隔着泥，听见你胸腔在响。
lines.en: Through the mud I hear your chest.

lines.zh: 这一鞭，藤蔓都带起来了。
lines.en: This lash pulls up vines with it.
This bone fist splits stone.
In the mangroves I walk on the water.
That crack was a reed, not me.

lines.zh: 进了红树林，就按树的规矩。
lines.en: In the mangroves, the trees make the rules.

lines.zh: 让开，红树根把我绊倒了。
lines.en: Move aside; mangrove roots tripped me.
The swamp vines strike for me.

lines.zh: 红树的根缠住你的腿了。
lines.en: Mangrove roots have your legs.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥没到我的膝盖，正好借力。
lines.en: Swamp mud reaches my knees, a fine brace.

lines.zh: 这只是藤梢，骨头还没上。
lines.en: That was only the vine tip, not the bone.
Toes feel first. Toward water.
The mud holds me as I rise.

lines.zh: 先晒晒这身湿骨，再说话。
lines.en: Let these wet bones dry first, then we talk.

lines.zh: 关节里的泥干了，掰不动。
lines.en: The mud in my joints dried stiff.
A vine threads between my ribs.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥没过我的脚踝。
lines.en: Swamp mud rises past my ankles.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥，没到我的膝盖
lines.en: Swamp mud up to my knees

lines.zh: 沼泽的水，漫到我的膝盖。
lines.en: Swamp water rises to my knees.

lines.zh: 泥底下躺久了，骨头都绿了。
lines.en: Long under mud, my bones turned green.
Birds, water — my bones startle.
A leaf on the vine tip. Mine.

lines.zh: 红树这么密，我从没来过。
lines.en: Mangroves this thick — never been here.
The vines caught! Smother them with mud!
Fell, and snapped a vine.

lines.zh: 憋住气，我这副骨头居然会憋。
lines.en: Hold my breath; even these bones can hold it.
The blast threw bone chips; the vines snapped.
The arrow went through two ribs and stuck.
Violet light runs down the vine into my bones.

lines.zh: 我这副骨架，连浆果都咬不动。
lines.en: Bare bones cannot bite a berry.
Lightning ran the vine; my bones lit up.
Nothing under me to grab hold of.
